Name: Better Mahogany Bench
Author: engineheart
Description:
Turning the mahogany bench around no longer breaks the fabric of reality.

This is my first mod and I'm not an artist by any stretch, so I'm open to feedback. Thanks!

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]ContentPatcher[/url]


Edit: v1.2 - Now configurable for different backrest styles!
Overkill for such a simple mod, I mainly did it just to learn how mod config works.

The options are: Wobbly Circles, Even Circles, Wobbly Ovals, Even Ovals, Plain
Either edit the mod's config.json manually with your preferred style or install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GenericModConfigMenu[/url]

Manifest.Name: Better Mahogany Bench
Manifest.Description: Fill the holes in the mahogany bench's backrest
